Privacy Policy | OneClickHuman.com

Effective Date: 23-01-2025

1. Introduction

Welcome to OneClickHuman.com. This Privacy Policy governs your access to and use of OneClickHuman.com, including any content, functionality, and services offered on or through our platform. We are committed to protecting the privacy of our users and their data. By using the website, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

2. Information We Collect

  • Personal Information:
    • Identification Data: We collect your names, email addresses, and contact details when you register or interact with our services.
    • Financial Information: For transactions, we collect payment details, which may include credit card numbers, security codes, and other related billing information.
  • Usage Data:
    • Analytics: We track the pages you visit, the time spent on each page, and the order of your navigation through our site.
    • Technical Data: Includes IP addresses, browser type, and your device’s operating system.
  • Cookies and Tracking Technologies:
    • Purpose: To enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content.
    • Types: Session cookies, persistent cookies, and tracking pixels.

3. How We Use Your Information

  • To Provide and Maintain our Service: Ensuring delivery of the services you need and prefer.
  • To Notify You about Changes: Alerting you to updates to our services or policy changes.
  • To Allow Participation in Interactive Features: Engaging you in interactive features when you choose to do so.
  • For Customer Support: Providing customer care and support.
  • For Data Analysis: Using data analytics to improve our website, services, marketing, user relationships, and experiences.
  • For Marketing and Promotions: Sending you information and updates on products, services, and promotions.

4. Sharing Your Information

  • With Service Providers: Sharing with third parties who provide services such as data analysis, payment processing, information technology, and related infrastructure, customer service, email delivery, and auditing services.
  • For Legal Reasons: Disclosing information in response to lawful requests by public authorities, including to meet national security or law enforcement requirements.
  • During Business Transfers: Sharing or transferring your personal information in connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business to another company.

5. Your Rights

  • Access and Receive: To access and receive a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
  • Request Correction: To correct any data about you that is incorrect.
  • Request Erasure: To delete your personal data, subject to certain exceptions.
  • Object to Processing: To object to our reliance on our legitimate interests as the basis for processing your personal data.
  • Request the Restriction of Processing: To request the restriction of processing of your personal data.
  • Request the Transfer: To request the transfer of your personal data to another company.
  • Withdraw Consent: Where the processing is based on your consent, you have the right to withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.

6. Data Security

We have implemented appropriate technical and organizational measures designed to secure your personal data from accidental loss and from unauthorized access, use, alteration, and disclosure. The safety and security of your information also depend on you.

7. Data Retention

We will retain your personal information only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We will retain and use your information to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve.
